messages:
Maya (oncall): OpsBot just paged high error rates for agent-exec timeouts in prod-us-west, looks correlated with a spike in 3rd-party integration calls. seeing 5xxs from the executor pool.
OpsBot: INCIDENT: agent-exec-timeout spike detected. Threshold breached: 120m requests in 5m window. Notified: @eng-sre oncall.
Sam (eng-sre): I'm jumping in. can someone snapshot active requests and route latencies?
Kevin (backend): grabbing traces now. early look: most slow requests are external-integration execs that call vendor A and B. tail latency > 8s.
Maya (oncall): impact: customer-facing chat generation degraded for ~30% of requests, some L2 customers reporting timeouts. CSM Anna notified.
Anna (CSM): FYI I already told two enterprise accounts we're investigating and will throttle non-essential features if needed.
Sam (eng-sre): plan: 1) apply soft rate limit on external-agent executions globally 2) disable structured-output (json-mode) for best-effort tiers 3) if no improvement, block external integration execs for free-tier.
Kevin (backend): agree. I can flip the rate limiter flag. doing a canary first on us-west-2.
Maya (oncall): tagging deployment steps so we can revert fast. Sam, post the exact toggles/commands you want.
Sam (eng-sre): config toggle (internal):
```
POST /admin/feature-toggle
{
  "feature": "ext_agent_exec_rate_limit",
  "mode": "soft",
  "value": 25  // requests/sec global
}
```
Apply to us-west canary: `curl -X POST https://api.internal/admin/feature-toggle -d '{...}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY'`
Kevin (backend): executing canary in us-west now.
DeployBot: deploy starting: feature-toggle ext_agent_exec_rate_limit -> soft=25 on canary us-west.
Sam (eng-sre): while that rolls, also prepare a policy to limit structured output size. small snippet to reduce heavy JSON generation:
```
PATCH /models/runtime-config
{
  "structured_output": {
    "enabled": "tiered",
    "max_bytes": 1024,
    "tiers": {
      "free": false,
      "standard": true,
      "enterprise": true
    }
  }
}
```
Maya (oncall): apply structured-output change immediately to free tier only. keep standard/enterprise intact for now.
Kevin (backend): change applied. free-tier structured_output=false. rolling config publish.
Sam (eng-sre): can we also stop agent-execution attempts that spawn external HTTP calls for streaming responses? add a guarded opt-out for streaming external tools.
Kevin (backend): added guard: `allow_external_exec && plan != free && plan != trial` now enforced.
OpsBot: Alert: canary shows 40% reduction in 5xxs and p95 latency down from 8.2s -> 3.1s.
Maya (oncall): nice. escalate to global after 2 more minutes of stability. meanwhile notify product and support.
Anna (CSM): sending template message to affected customers: "We're applying temporary limits to external integrations to restore latency; full feature remains for enterprise customers." cc @Maya
Sam (eng-sre): ok promoting rate-limit globally.
DeployBot: deploy complete: ext_agent_exec_rate_limit -> soft=25 global.
OpsBot: Metric update: 5xxs down 62%, request latency p95 at 2.9s, error budget dropping slower.
Maya (oncall): follow-up mitigation: create targeted quotas per-tenant to avoid hitting central pool. Sam, can you draft a quick command to set tenant quota to 10 ext-execs/min?
Sam (eng-sre): tenant quota API:
```
POST /admin/tenant-quota
{
  "tenant_id": "<TENANT>",
  "quota": {
    "external_exec_per_min": 10
  }
}
```
I'll run for high-volume tenants only.
Kevin (backend): done for tenants flagged in the incident runbook. also added a short-circuit to fall back to local-model variant instead of calling external tools when quota exceeded.
Maya (oncall): customer impact notes: free and trial users lose structured JSON outputs and external-tool streaming; standard users get degraded rate (25rps global) but can still use structured output. enterprise unchanged.
Anna (CSM): sharing status to our support channel, included workaround steps (use local model or smaller prompt).
Sam (eng-sre): monitoring dashboards show stabilization but some residual errors from vendor B. reaching out to infra to throttle vendor-specific retries to avoid amplification.
Kevin (backend): added retry-backoff cap on vendor B: max_retries=1, backoff=500ms.
OpsBot: NOTE: Incident alert suppressed; currently in mitigation window.
Maya (oncall): I'm going to hand off to Sam for overnight monitoring. I'll draft the incident summary for postmortem and coordinate customer comms with Anna in the morning.
Sam (eng-sre): ack. I'll keep a watch and escalate if p95 goes above 4s. leaving link to runbook and commands used:
- feature toggle: ext_agent_exec_rate_limit -> soft=25
- structured_output: free=false
- tenant quotas applied to 18 tenants
- vendor B retries capped
Maya (oncall): thanks. final ask: record exact CLI commands and timestamps for postmortem.
Kevin (backend): logging saved, will attach traces and the vendor call error snapshots.
Anna (CSM): any ETA for when free-tier structured json will be re-enabled? need to tell customers.
Sam (eng-sre): tentative plan: keep soft limits for 4 hours, reassess metrics. if stable for 2h, re-enable structured_output for free but keep quotas.
Maya (oncall): marking incident as mitigated for now. moving to monitoring state.
OpsBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated at 1732110199.
Maya (oncall): handing to Sam. Sam, please create a follow-up thread for the postmortem and tag infra and product.
Sam (eng-sre): will do. creating postmortem thread and collecting artifacts.
Anna (CSM): I'll follow up with the two customers I directly notified. thanks team :heart:
__notes: This thread string contains root + replies, messages in chronological order, includes bots and config snippets.
